protocol.reader: question-blind, identity-free (one embedding for every node token), slot and clipped relative-offset positions, hard 0/1 adjacency with a straight-through gradient

purpose: reader → anchored solver: can the graph come from the edge-list text?

regimes.answers_frozen: reader trained on reachability answers only; solver trained on true graphs first, then frozen
regimes.answers_joint: reader and solver both untrained at the start, trained on reachability answers only
regimes.supervised: reader trained on the true edges; solver trained on true graphs first, then frozen
